references
Develop, teach, and maintain assigned courses, ensuring alignment with program goals and accreditation requirements.

Guide students in developing, refining, and completing a capstone project such as: clinical practice improvement initiative, research project or systematic review, leadership or policy review, or educational innovation project.
Approve topic proposals, project plans, IRB needs (if applicable), and deliverable timelines.
Ensure integrity of academic standards including adherence to IRB/ethics, HIPAA considerations, responsible conduct of research, and APA or discipline-specific scholarly formats.
Provide timely, constructive, and scholarly feedback aligned with course rubrics and doctoral expectations.
Maintain open lines of communication via email, LMS, or virtual meetings.
Upload course materials, manage grades, and communicate with students via the institution’s LMS (e.g., Canvas, Blackboard).
Monitor student progress and engagement using LMS tools.
Participate in adjunct faculty meetings, course evaluations, and curriculum updates as requested.
Coordinate with lead faculty or program directors on course improvements and student outcomes.
Ability to teach online using active learning pedagogies and advise team-based projects.
Demonstrated ability to analyze and present complex issues to diverse individuals and groups.
Strong attention to detail.
Excellent oral and written communication skills.
Proficient computer, online system, and web skills.
Strong work ethic and team-based approach to working in a high-volume environment.
Positive, welcoming personality with demonstrated customer service experience.
Ability to maintain the highest level of confidentiality.
Ability to work comfortably, respectfully, and competently with people of diverse backgrounds.
Ability to handle multiple responsibilities simultaneously.
